records.title: Australia Visa Photo
records.expression: Neutral expression (not smiling, laughing or frowning), eyes open, mouth closed. Look straight at the camera with your face centred and your hair off your face so its edges are visible.
records.glasses: Remove glasses. If you cannot remove them for a medical reason, the lenses must be untinted (unless tint is medically needed), free of reflections, and the frames must not cover your eyes. Needing glasses to see is not on its own a medical reason.
records.head_covering: Religious head coverings are allowed if your whole face is visible, from the bottom of the chin to the top of the forehead and both edges of the face, including the outer corners of the eyes. The covering must be plain, without patterns.
records.children: Every applicant needs a photo, including children. Babies under 3 may have their mouth open; all other rules apply. No other person or object, such as a parent or a toy, may be visible.
